title: spec(ui): action:icon and action:group/menu members refuse confirmText beside an array params (ruling A)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

Ruled: 6624208841 · letter A
Ruling-ref: 6624208841

Filing gate: ② a decision the maintainer made. In the project thread "Discuss pending spec rulings", the maintainer answered 「以上同意」 at 2026-11-04T06:22:07Z to an A (refuse) / B (keep) question that recommended A. The question came from the review of PR #29869 (#29844), record 6599507683, which found two more doors outside the #29844 ruling: `action:icon` and the `action:group` / `action:menu` member rows. The ruling text is recorded as this card's first comment. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 (the same family as #29844 and #29383).

**Business reason.** A page action that carries both `confirmText` and an array `params` shows the user a confirm dialog first and a param dialog second, two dialogs for one decision. `ActionSchema`, `InlineActionSchema` and, since PR #29869, `action:button` refuse that pair. `action:icon` and the members of `action:group` / `action:menu` still accept it. Reader: the `domain:spec` seat (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`).

## What the code does (at `origin/main` `eee41490`)

- `ActionIconPropsSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` ≈:4055) carries `description`, `params: z.unknown()` and `confirmText`, with no pair rule.
- `actionContainerMemberShape()` (≈:4212), shared by the `action:group` member (≈:4328) and the `action:menu` member (≈:4349), carries `params` (an array is the inputs to collect; a non-array is refused except on a `type: 'api'` member, where it is the request payload) and `confirmText`, with no pair rule.
- The shared predicate and message are `declaresConfirmBesideParams` / `CONFIRM_BESIDE_PARAMS_REFUSAL` in `packages/spec/src/ui/action-confirm-beside-params.ts`, already used by `action:button` (≈:4010).

## Wanted (ruling A)

- `ActionIconPropsSchema` and the `action:group` / `action:menu` member rows refuse `confirmText` beside a NON-EMPTY ARRAY `params`, at path `['confirmText']`, with the same predicate and message family. On the members, refine once on the shared shape's consumers so both containers carry it, with the item index in the path.
- Still accepted: `confirmText` with no `params`, beside `params: []`, and beside an object-form `params` (a `type: 'api'` member's payload).
- Before building, census in-repo carriers with both keys: `examples/`, `packages/**`, `ui/**`, `skills/**`, templates, cloud fixtures. Zero shipped carriers were known at ruling time.
- Declarations: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `@objectstack/spec` minor, and an ADR-0087 disposition (precedent: PR #29869).

Serial: after PR #29869 (merged). One S PR.

Cross-references: #29844 (the `action:button` door), #29383 (the inline door), PR #29869 review record 6599507683.

Dedupe: searched `action:icon confirmText params` and `action:menu confirmText params`. The only hits are #29844 and #29383. **New.**
